name: @zutools/workspace
description: Local-first browser tools and framework-independent JavaScript engines.
author: ZU Tools contributors

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@zutools/core && npm run build --workspace=@zutools/react
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:packages
scripts.examples:test: npm run examples:prepare && npm run build --prefix examples/vanilla && npm run build --prefix examples/react
scripts.example:vanilla: npm run examples:prepare && npm run dev --prefix examples/vanilla
scripts.example:react: npm run examples:prepare && npm run dev --prefix examples/react
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run release:check && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@zutools/core && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=@zutools/react
